title: Advent Calendar
loadError: Failed to load the advent calendar.

enabled.title: Show advent calendar
enabled.description: While on, every user sees the calendar from 1 December to 6 January. Super admins can always preview it on the calendar page.

doors.title: Doors
doors.description: Door N opens at midnight (Berlin time) on N December. A door only needs content by its day.

clearConfirm.title: Clear door {{day}}?
clearConfirm.description: Its title, text, buttons and image are deleted, and the door is empty until it is filled again.

media.label: Media
media.imageDescription: JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP, up to 10 MB. Uploaded when the door is saved.

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to two buttons, at most one of them a quiz.
buttons.urlDescription: An https:// address opens in a new tab, an in-app path such as /marketplace in the same tab.
buttons.promptDescription: Filled into a new chat without being sent.

toast.enabled: The advent calendar is switched on.
toast.disabled: The advent calendar is switched off.
toast.enabledError: Failed to switch the advent calendar.
toast.imageError: The text was saved, but the image could not be changed.
